notes.title: Bluebird G&B News [Update!!]
notes.notes:
We will announce the good news and bad news.

Bad news.
- Bluebird will finish (every part) next year. During the first quarter
(formerly from this year).
- Bluebird will no longer have characters voice. (in this version)
- Bluebird doesn't make Physic Disc. (so much money to handle)
- Bluebird was cut some story to save the budget in the game.

Good news.
- Bluebird status is "QC&Dev Chapter 2"
- Bluebird will be available next month (but the day still not sure) 
at the price of 399 THB or 11.99 USD (Buy once, Get ALL EP) 
the schedule will be released by:

Chapter 1 + Chapter 2 | Chapter 3 | Chapter 4 + Chapter 5 (END)

Just FYI

KimoiEngineGuy.

If you want to ask me. feel free to ask me on 
 - http://steamcommunity.com/app/434600/discussions/
or Facebook https://www.facebook.com/DLSoft/

Thank you. :)
